name: Tasks
description: Your projects' md task lists on one screen; everything you write goes to the file.

settings.label: Projects
settings.hint: Each project: id, name, folder, files or pattern, finishDate, doneList, icon. To keep an eye on a repo's GitHub issues and pull requests, add github (owner/repo); folder is then optional, and githubLists can narrow them, as in ["pulls"]
